The 18:05:30 slow audit_log query came earlier but doesn't explain duplicate keys, so I treated it as unrelated.

verdict.recommendedAction: Run setval('orders_id_seq', (SELECT max(id) FROM orders)+1) to move the sequence past the highest existing ID, then confirm inserts succeed. Then check the restore runbook so sequences are always reset after a restore.
